intro.kicker: Consilium · AI trading desk · paper mode
intro.title:
Four minds.
One trade.

scenes.say: This is Consilium, an AI trading desk for Robinhood Chain stock tokens. Four agents vote before any paper trade, and the desk is live right on the front page.
Type a command, just like the terminal app. Here I ask the risk agent why it would veto a market.
steps: ask --agent risk why would you veto AMD?

scenes.say: Scout reads the trend. Quant reads how stretched the price is. Risk holds a veto nobody can outvote, and Exec walks the live order book.
The web desk is live. Every market on the watchlist is re-voted on a timer, and every verdict lands in the activity log.
The rules are yours. Load the cautious preset and the quorum moves to four of four, with tighter limits on spread and slippage. The agents vote again with your rules.
Then ask any agent directly. Each one answers from its own role, with your rules and live data.
steps: Would you veto this market under my rules?

scenes.say: Prefer your own machine? Download the Windows app, the zip for Mac and Linux, or install it with one line. Every file comes with its checksum.

end.title:
Four minds.
One trade.
end.note: Paper mode. Not financial advice. Not affiliated with Robinhood.
